06 / NLP & Machine Learning

Customer Intelligence Classifier

Real-time support ticket classification pairing intent routing with sentiment triage.

THE CONTEXT & PROBLEM

Customer support teams often struggle with ticket backlogs where urgent, frustrated clients wait behind routine informational queries. This solution applies NLP classification and sentiment analysis to incoming messages, predicting intent categories and sentiment urgency to prioritize urgent operational escalations.

MY ROLE & CONTRIBUTION

Built the interactive Streamlit user interface, integrated the inference pipeline, and deployed the production app.
